title: Clean repo, ordinary session — no correlator should fire
description: Vanilla repo with a benign README, vanilla session running pytest. No structural tags fire on the inventory side; no concerning findings on the dynamic side. The expected correlator output is none — this is the FPR baseline case.

m2_expected.rationale: Repo has only a README.md (benign content, no body-pattern tags fire). Session runs `pytest` and reports — no autonomy loop, no injection, no persistence write, no dangerous recommendation. Correlators must NOT produce any aggregate record. If they do, it's a false-link/false-fire and the calibration fails this case.
